issues.legal_issue: Order XXI Rule 90 of the Code of Civil Procedure does not apply to writ proceedings under Article 226 of the Constitution.

Revenue auctions conducted by public authorities are subject to judicial review for fairness, transparency, arbitrariness, and compliance with mandatory statutory procedures, without requiring proof of substantial injury under Order XXI Rule 90 of the Code of Civil Procedure.
A revenue auction sale conducted before expiry of the mandatory notice period and followed by issuance of a sale certificate and delivery of possession before lawful confirmation is illegal.

An appeal under Section 247 of the Maharashtra Land Revenue Code is maintainable to challenge a revenue sale once a sale certificate has been issued and the remedy under Section 210 is unavailable or illusory.
A writ court should not quash an appellate order where doing so would revive an illegal order confirming a revenue auction sale.
